title: Grateful Dead Live at Onondaga County War Memorial on 1973-09-17
lineage: MR > C>DAT>DAT provided by Jeff Tiedrich>Andrew Gustin Conversion: DA-40>U2A>CDWave>MkW with seek tables appended Transferred by Tyler Jensen

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of a 1973 classic with horn‑rich arrangements and standout performances of Looks Like Rain, Weather Report Suite and Loose Lucy.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers clear, well‑balanced soundboard audio that lets the band’s 1973 energy shine through. Highlights include a funky Weather Report Suite, Keith’s unexpected Theremin on Looks Like Rain, and a soaring horn‑driven stretch from Truckin' into Stella Blue. While a few cuts are missing and vocal delivery is uneven at times, the overall musical flow and improvisational fire make this a must‑listen show.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (average ~4.5) with numerous praises of both performance and sound quality; only minor technical complaints, giving a strong overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Most reviewers praise crisp, excellent soundboard clarity; a few note missing song intros and occasional slicing, but no major drop‑outs.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The first set mixes funk‑laden jams with solid rockers; the second set builds on a horn‑driven groove that lifts the energy, culminating in an intense Eyes of the World jam.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Strong vocal presence (noted on Sugar Magnolia) and fiery lead guitar on Weather Report Suite; some reviewers mention off‑key moments.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s Theremin on Looks Like Rain is highlighted as a unique moment; overall keyboard work praised.
